title: McCasland-DeLonge contacts as a disclosure operation meant to pave the way for a Hillary Clinton presidency

tellings.quote: when I say op, it's not a bad thing. That was an operation, meaning there were people trying to get [ __ ] out.

plain: In 2015 and 2016, a retired Air Force general named Neil McCasland was in contact with the rock musician Tom DeLonge, and the UFO journalist Jeremy Corbell tells Michels this was an "operation" meant to get UFO secrets out in time for a Hillary Clinton presidency. Corbell leans on an email published by WikiLeaks and on the TV reporter George Knapp, and stresses that "op" is not an insult: "there were people trying to get [it] out." If so, insiders were planning a release of UFO information around the 2016 election.
